about: I'm Gabriel, an Analytics Engineer passionate about making data work smarter, not harder. I focus on building scalable, automated solutions that streamline workflows, improve data accessibility, and help teams make faster, more informed decisions.

My work combines data engineering, automation, and business intelligence. I have designed end-to-end data pipelines using Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, and Microsoft Fabric (Power BI and Dataflows), as well as developed custom automation tools for document scanning, data collection, and business calculators that support operational and strategic needs.

Beyond engineering solutions, I have led and owned multiple end-to-end analytics projects that answered critical business questions and delivered actionable insights to executive leadership. By transforming complex data into clear recommendations, I help bridge the gap between technical implementation and business strategy.

I keep things clear, efficient, and practical. My goal is to build systems that not only produce accurate results but also integrate seamlessly into everyday workflows, turning manual, repetitive processes into reliable solutions that save time, improve data quality, and empower strategy, sales, and leadership teams.

roles.title: Analytics Engineer II
roles.description: Built AI-powered analytics and automation solutions using Python, Microsoft Fabric, and Power Automate to streamline data workflows, improve data quality, and support strategic business decision-making.

roles.title: Data Analyst I
roles.description: Automated data collection and ETL development using Python and developed a Flask web app. Performed data and statistical analytics with Power BI visualization to support business intelligence and decision-making.

roles.title: Electronics Engineer Intern
roles.description: Analyzed device performance using descriptive statistics, developed electronic and robotic systems with C++, Arduino, and ESP32, and demonstrated strengths in teamwork, communication, and leadership.

projects.title: LAPD Crime Data Analysis
projects.description: Built a complete end-to-end data pipeline and analytical workflow for processing, cleaning, normalizing, and visualizing LAPD crime data using SQL Server, Power BI, and a modern data warehouse approach.

projects.title: Netflix Relational Database
projects.description: Cleaned, transformed, and modeled a Netflix dataset into a star schema using MySQL and Excel, and built an interactive dashboard in Power BI.

projects.title: COVID-19 Insights: Muntinlupa City 2020
projects.description: Extracted, cleaned, and analyzed over 1M rows of COVID-19 data using MySQL and Excel. A Tableau dashboard was developed to present key metrics and identify trends and patterns.
